description: "Poems" by Denis Florence MacCarthy is a collection of poetry published in the late 19th century, specifically in 1882. This volume includes a range of lyrical and narrative poetry, focusing on themes of nature, love, and national pride, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of Ireland.
